note.registration: Fixed generated pad during writing; explicit pad-body baseline for the generated page turn; common uniform scale

assembly.method: Crop and reuse generated pad, pen and handwriting pixels; reveal each stroke with a left-to-right alpha clip while translating the pen. The pen silhouette occludes the page beneath it. Preserve generated cels 14 through 19 for finishing, curl, page turn and settling. All page cels use the same uniform scale and an explicit pad-body bottom anchor.
